home.about-text: Music Blender is a multiplayer blind test that brings together each player's playlists. Copy the link of your favorite playlist and join a game to start playing.
home.step1: Create a game or join one with the game code
home.step2: Add the link to your favorite playlist
home.step3: Guess the song title and artist and win points

home.about-text-1: Music Blender is a multiplayer blind test that brings together each player's playlists.
home.about-text-2: Copy the link to your favorite playlist and join a game to start playing.
home.faq-a1: The available platforms are Spotify, Deezer, and Apple Music. If you would like to see other platforms added, please feel free to contact us.
home.faq-q2: How to add a playlist from Spotify?
home.faq-a2:
1. Go to Spotify and find the playlist you want to share (the playlist must be public).
  2. Click the three dots (...) next to the playlist name.
  3. Click 'Share', then 'Copy link'.
  4. Paste this link in the field provided in the app.
home.faq-q3: How to add a playlist from Deezer?
home.faq-a3:
1. Go to Deezer and find the playlist you want to share (the playlist must be public).
  2. Click the 'Share' button next to the playlist name.
  3. Click 'Copy'.
  4. Paste this link in the field provided in the app.
home.faq-q4: How to add a playlist from Apple Music?
home.faq-a4:
1. Go to Apple Music and find the playlist you want to share (the playlist must be public).
  2. Click the three dots (...) next to the playlist name.
  3. Click 'Copy link'.
  4. Paste this link in the field provided in the app.

mentions.title: Legal Notice & Privacy Policy
mentions.privacy-intro: The protection of your privacy and personal data is a priority. This privacy policy explains in full transparency what data is processed when you use the game, for what purposes, and how it is managed.
mentions.section1-text: The game is designed according to the principle of data minimization: no data is kept long-term. Data processing is temporary, strictly limited to the duration of a game session, and hosted in volatile memory (RAM).
mentions.section2-intro: During your browsing and games, we only process the following elements:
mentions.purpose-username: Identify the player to other participants in the lobby.
mentions.duration-username: Deleted as soon as the lobby is closed. (May be stored locally in your browser for convenience).
mentions.purpose-room-code: Allow players to join the same multiplayer game.
mentions.duration-room-code: Deleted as soon as the game ends or all players leave the lobby.
mentions.purpose-playlist-url: Load and synchronize audio tracks for the current game.
mentions.duration-playlist-url: Deleted when the lobby is closed.
mentions.purpose-game-data: Ensure correct functioning of real-time game mechanics via WebSockets (scores, answers, game state).
mentions.duration-game-data: Automatically deleted as soon as all players leave the lobby.
mentions.purpose-music-list: Optimize loading and avoid repetitive requests during the session (Technical Cache).
mentions.duration-music-list: Temporarily stored in cache memory and purged regularly.
mentions.data-policy-notice: No data is sold, transferred, or shared with advertising networks or third parties for marketing purposes.
mentions.section3-text1: Immediate Deletion: As soon as all players leave a game lobby, all data linked to that lobby (lobby, usernames, scores, game states) is permanently erased from the server's memory.
mentions.section3-text2: No Persistent Database: No information relating to your games, history, or gaming habits is stored in a permanent database.
mentions.section4-text1: This website does not use any advertising cookies, third-party trackers, or invasive audience analysis tools (like Google Analytics).
mentions.section4-text2: Only strictly technical elements necessary for the service to function may be placed on your device:
mentions.section4-bullet1: Convenience Local Storage: Your browser may store your last username or the last room code locally to prevent you from typing them again upon reloading the page.
mentions.section4-text3: In accordance with CNIL and GDPR recommendations, these purely technical trackers do not require prior consent via a banner. If you wish to delete these local elements, you can do so at any time:
mentions.section4-bullet2: Directly from your browser settings (section "History" -> "Clear browsing data / Cookies and site data").
mentions.section4-bullet3: Via your browser's developer tools (F12 -> Application or Storage tab -> Local Storage / Cookies -> Clear).
mentions.section5-text1: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data.
mentions.section5-text2: Given the absence of persistent storage and user accounts, leaving the game and closing your browser de facto deletes all your session data.
